Some RPG content made for evidently DnD (5E) by TDL. Below is a description:
——
Going through various roles in her life- courtesan, pirate, adventurer, and now draconic servant- Thyra de Ramour finds herself in thrall to a great dragon and bound in his service. Serving as his emissary and factor, consort and retainer, she enjoys the prestigious position of draconic consort, and the privileges that come with serving- and being owned by- a dragon. Her master subsidizes her studies and crafting- all of which build the power of his servant, the majesty of his hoard, and the grandeur of his prize. She carries out his will, speaks with his voice, and brightens- sometimes literally- his lair.
